ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity (dark grey/black) dominant surface with approximately 15-20% high intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in punctate spots and linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-tone base with scattered white mottling across both lobes; highest concentration of contiguous white blobs is located on the lateral tips and along the trailing edge serrations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior vertex approximately 35-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; edge profile shows significant jaggedness particularly on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, circular white pixel groupings (acorn barnacles) densely populated on the upper-right lateral margin and the upper-left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) appearing as thin white scratches across the central and lower portions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal margins and prominent white rake marks/scars across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe displays a significant accumulation of calcified organisms along the outer margin, creating a distinctively thickened and irregular pixel silhouette compared to the left lobe.
